name: electron-migration-initial-budgets

units.memory: KiB, sum of owned process RSS or WorkingSet; shared pages can be counted more than once
units.cpu: percent, one logical CPU equals 100; cumulative CPU differences over the complete sampling window
units.wakeups: per second; Electron process coverage only, unavailable on Windows and for other helpers

policy: Initial absolute migration acceptance limits fixed before measurement. Do not relax limits after observing a result. Missing measurements are unavailable, never a successful zero. These limits do not establish a comparison with another client.
